instructions: Cambia de objetivo sin terminar un cast inútil contra el escudo.
Prioriza el wisp que aparece más lejos.
Sostén a Tangata mientras ayudas con el wisp más cercano.
Quédate fuera del primer círculo.
En cuanto explote, entra a esa zona para evitar los donuts siguientes.
Cura cualquier daño previo antes de ejecutar el intercambio fuera-dentro.

The second phase starts after the four fighters are defeated. A red demon (Naraasimha) and a Lalafell named Mumuepo the Beholden show up. Yhe tank should pick up both of them. Kill Mumoepo first because he casts more and chains players in place before starting a massive AoE with a slow cast bar (Thal's Fury). The remaining unchained players needs to save them by finding the "Thal's Scepter" interactive object in the AoE to unchain their party members before the cast finishes so the chained players can escape, or they will take high damage. Once Mumoepo goes down, the rest of the fight is unremarkable. The red demon thing has a rear tail swipe, so keep that in mind if you're melee, and ranged will have to deal with a targeted AoE circle randomly at their location.

*Void Fire II is an interruptible AoE spell, typically targeted on a player at range from the boss (ranged DPS, healer).

Manor Claviger has an untelegraphed melee cleaver attack. The attack can do massive physical damage to lightly armored party members. Make sure the tank faces her away from the rest of the party. When defeated, the doors leading to the Foyer will open, and Claviger will drop a Green Key. Do not go forward to the Foyer. Instead, proceed back out of the entrance of the boss room and use the Green Key to unlock the Ivy Door.

Prioridad: Manor Jester primero, Manor Steward después.
Interrumpe Ice Spikes y aléjate de Soul Drain.
El Jester hace más daño; vigila picos mientras ambos viven.
Stun al Steward durante Soul Drain si está disponible.
Interrumpe Ice Spikes si tu job tiene interrupt.
Mantén a ambos enemigos juntos y girados lejos del grupo.

Manor Jester and Manor Steward are two bosses located in the same room. Jester is the spell caster and Steward is the tank. Players should kill Jester first because it deals more damage and has less HP. When defeated, Steward will drop a slip of Bloody Parchment. As of Patch 6.1, there is a teleporter that will return you to the entrance of the dungeon afterwards. Then, use the Bloody Parchment to unlock the Sealed Barrier along the stairs.

Cuando aparezca el ojo, gira la cámara y el personaje para mirar en dirección contraria al Sentry.
Puedes colocarte entre la jefa y el add para seguir atacando sin mirarlo.

Cambia de objetivo antes de completar daño innecesario al boss.
Prioriza la handmaiden aunque aparezca lejos.
Mitiga Void Thunder III si no se interrumpe; funciona como tankbuster.

Manor Jester will cast Void Blizzard. The spell will not only damage players but also applies the debuff Slow. Healers should remove the debuff with Esuna. Additionally, players should kill the adds that spawn and avoid the AoE ice patches spawned by the boss.

Players who are not the tank should not stand in front of the boss to avoid its cleave attacks. Always be ready to move to avoid the glowing blue spirit cutters. Avoid swirling swords spawned by the boss. When the boss casts Abyssal Transfixion and places the debuff Paralysis on a player, healer should remove it ASAP. When the boss spawns the add, kill the add as soon as possible.

Players who are not the tank should not stand in front of the boss to avoid its cleave attacks. Always be ready to move to avoid the glowing blue spirit cutters. Avoid swirling swords spawned by the boss. When the boss casts Abyssal Transfixion and places the debuff Paralysis on a player, healer should remove it ASAP. When the boss spawns the add, kill the add as soon as possible.

Once the final add is dead, the tank should drag the boss to the center of the room. At about 15% HP, she will use Beguiling Mist. While she casts this spell, it will Charm all players and cause them to walk towards the boss. She will target one player with Void Fire IV, an AoE that deals moderate damage. This will repeat three times. If you haven't killed her after the third Beguiling Mist, she will absorb a random party member and the resulting Blood Rain will wipe the group. This DPS race is much easier than the add waves, but make sure to kill her before the third Beguiling Mist.
The Tentacle will follow the tank to whichever Platform they are on, making it annoying to attack if the tank is jumping around a lot. Try to stay in one place if not dodging a World's End.
Evita las zonas bajas cuando aparezca el veneno.
No amontones los esqueletos junto al dragón.
Prepárate para daño grupal si un esqueleto llega al cadáver.
Usa daño de objetivo individual; no juntes sus muertes.
Cambia a Platinals y sepáralos antes de rematarlos.
Distribuye daño entre esqueletos alejados.
Orienta al dragón lejos del grupo y recoge los adds sueltos.
Mata cada Platinal antes de que toque al dragón.
Cada llegada inflige daño inevitable a toda la alianza.
Cura en área después de cada impacto que no se pueda evitar.
Reserva instantáneos para rematar objetivos en movimiento.
Persigue el objetivo más cercano al cadáver.
Prioriza el esqueleto con menos distancia restante.
Intercepta y controla esqueletos sin volverlos a juntar.
Quema al Bone Dragon y evita AoE.

*Healers should be prepared to heal the party if/when the skeletons reach the dragon.

The raid will need to divide into their 3 groups based on their party (A, B, C): 1 for each path, which each has a platform. 4 people need to stand on each platform (preferably both healers, the tank, and one remaining DPS to kill adds) to light up the platform, which allows the other groups to kill their respective Atomos. Atomos does not need to be tanked but will continuously spawn adds (Valefors and Diras) that should be killed. Adds will always move to the pad unless otherwise aggroed, and healers on the platform can use AoE heals to produce threat if necessary, making it possible for all Atomos DPS to remain on Atomos. If non-platform DPS begin to aggro adds, instead of focusing Atomos, the tank will need to pick up adds aggro regardless of platform count. If a sector does not contain enough people to stand on the platform, once the room is sealed, several Iron Giants will spawn and quickly wipe the raid in order for the encounter to reset.

**Players on the JP data centers will tank the Bone Dragon on the center platform. This allows for an even spread of adds around the room, while minimizing confusion on where to pull the adds as 1 spawns per "path". This will also reduce damage taken by the DPS, as they will spend more time on the raised sections out of the poison.

**Players on the NA/EU data centers will tank the Bone Dragon on the far edge of the arena directly behind its spawn, as this will give DPS enough time to kill the Platinals even if they are racing towards the Bone Dragon due to being positioned incorrectly.

*If you have File:Astral realignment icon1.png Astral Realignment and are ghostly, DPS the boss. If not, kill adds. Healers should keep the pots alive.

Thanatos is “ghostly” and cannot be harmed ordinarily. At the beginning of the fight, one of the Magic Pots will shoot green lines out to several alliance members, giving them a buff called File:Astral realignment icon1.png Astral Realignment. The first group to receive the buff is always A. File:Astral realignment icon1.png Astral Realignment allows you to deal damage to the boss. A tank with the buff should pick up the boss immediately, and a tank swap should occur whenever a tank picks up File:Astral realignment icon1.png Astral Realignment and the one on the boss loses it. Thanatos does have a cleave, so he should be faced away from the group and the pots.

Allagan Bomb initially does nothing. Each group takes one of the Vassagos with the large swords (A left, B north, C right - waymarks may sometimes be used to denote each party's add). Those Vassagos WILL NOT aggro anyone automatically, so each tank should stand in front of each adds to avoid the boss running to the middle. The boss will periodically spawn Allagan Balloon adds that need to be killed (high priority) before they reach the center, or they will explode and cause the Allagan Bomb to enlarge. If the bomb enlarges too much, it will explode and wipe the raid. In addition, an Allagan Napalm add may spawn and will have the highest priority to kill. The boss can be damaged once the 3 adds are down.
*Non-tanks should not be directly in front of a Vassago, because they will periodically used untelegraphed frontal cleaves.

The arena contains interact-able towers. Each tower should be covered by one ranged DPS or healer, activating it when it begins to glow. (For a typical Duty Finder run, this mechanic can be ignored). Puroboros (bomb) adds will also spawn and move towards the towers, but they are less important than Iron Giants.

Iron Giant adds will spawn early in the fight. The tanks who are not tanking the boss should pick these up and face them away from other players or meteors that drop later, as they will use untelegraphed frontal cleaves.
